children: TORONTO, ON - TheNewswire - October 06, 2026 / Cloud3 Ventures Inc.

(OTCQB:CLDVF)(FSE:WQ40) ("Cloud3 Ventures" or the "Company"), is pleased to announce that it intends to change its name from Cloud3 Ventures Inc. to Aeon Strategies Ltd. (the “Name Change”) to better reflect the Company’s long-term vision and investment strategy.

In connection with the Name Change, the Company will be changing its trading symbol to AEON and the Company’s common shares will continue to trade on the Canadian Securities Exchange (“CSE”) under the new company name and ticker symbol (Aeon Strategies Ltd. and AEON, respectively) as of market open on October 09, 2026.
The new CUSIP and ISIN numbers assigned to the Company’s common shares are 00784F108 and CA00784F1080, respectively.

Cloud3 Ventures Inc. is an investment issuer focused on investing in high-potential companies operating across a variety of industries and sectors. The goal of the Company is to generate maximum returns from its investments.
